strategy: 方块遮挡与表面积对应

questions.question: A block is made from equal numbers of white cubes and colored cubes. How many white cubes are not visible in the picture?
Painting the whole cube requires $9 \mathrm{~kg}$ of ink. How many kilograms of ink are required to paint the white surface?
The number 2022 shown is built by gluing together 66 cubes of the same size. The entire surface of the resulting structure is painted. How many of the 66 cubes have exactly four painted faces?
A solid is formed by stacking $14$ cubes, each with an edge of $1$ meter, on the ground as shown. Its exposed surface is painted. What area, in square meters, is painted?

Fourteen white cubes are put together to form the figure on the right. The complete surface of the figure, including the bottom, is painted red. The figure is then separated into individual cubes. How many of the individual cubes have exactly four red faces?

Every one of these six building blocks consists of 5 little cubes. The little cubes are either white or grey. Cubes of equal colour don't touch each other. How many little white cubes are there in total?
The block shown is constructed from red and blue cubes of the same size. Its outside is completely red, and all cubes inside are blue. How many blue cubes are used?
How many cubes have been taken from the block?
The structure shown is glued together from 10 cubes. Its entire exterior, including the bottom, is painted. How many cube faces are painted?
The big cube is made up of three different kinds of building blocks (see diagram). How many of the little white cubes are needed for this big cube?

A cube has side length $12 \mathrm{~cm}$. Find the length of the route shown on its surface from point $M$ to point $N$.
Choices:
A:40 cm
B:48 cm
C:50 cm
D:60 cm
E:It is impossible to determine

A rectangular section was cut out of a rectangular block as shown in the diagram. Find the decrease percentage of the surface area.
Choices:
A:Less than $12.5 \%$
B:$12.5 \%$
C:More than $12.5 \%$, but less than $25 \%$
D:$25 \%$
E:More than $25 \%$

The sculpture shown is made by gluing together cubic boxes with side length half a meter. Its surface, excluding the support base, is painted. Each can of paint covers 4 square meters. How many cans of paint are needed?

A cuboid consists of three building blocks. Each building block has a different colour and is made up of 4 cubes. What does the white building block look like?
Choices:
A:A
B:B
C:C
D:D
E:E

The cube shown is built from equally sized bricks. The shortest side of one brick is $4 \mathrm{~cm}$ long. What are the dimensions of one brick in $\mathrm{cm}$?
Choices:
A:$4 \times 6 \times 12$
B:$4 \times 6 \times 16$
C:$4 \times 8 \times 12$
D:$4 \times 8 \times 16$
E:$4 \times 12 \times 16$

The object pictured is made up of four equally sized cubes. Each cube has a surface area of $24 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$. What is the surface area of the object pictured?
Choices:
A:$80 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
B:$64 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
C:$40 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
D:$32 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
E:$24 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$

The cuboid shown has been built using four shapes, each made from four small cubes. Three of the shapes can be completely seen, but the dark one is only partly visible. Which of the following shapes could be the dark one?
Choices:
A:A
B:B
C:C
D:D
E:E
Four cubes, each with surface area $24 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$, are placed together to form a cuboid as shown. What is the surface area of this cuboid, in $\mathrm{cm}^{2}$?

All six sides of a rectangular solid were rectangles.  A one-foot cube was cut out of the rectangular solid as shown.  The total number of square feet in the surface of the new solid is how many more or less than that of the original solid?

Choices:
A:$2\text{ less}$
B:$1\text{ less}$
C:$\text{the same}$
D:$1\text{ more}$
E:$2\text{ more}$
Six cubes, each an inch on an edge, are fastened together, as shown.  Find the total surface area in square inches.  Include the top, bottom and sides.
